30-day In-hospital Mortality.rationale: All-cause mortality within the declared 28-90 day / in-hospital window; same event definition as the review's Mortality outcome.

In-hospital Mortality.rationale: All-cause in-hospital mortality matches the declared outcome's in-hospital option and definition.

Intensive Care Unit Free Days to Day 28.candidate_definition: count of days alive and free of the ICU through day 28 (a continuous composite of survival and ICU stay)
Intensive Care Unit Free Days to Day 28.rationale: ICU-free days is a continuous survival-and-length-of-stay composite, NOT all-cause mortality; different endpoint despite the shared 'intensive care' keyword.
